Interface ICreateProjectTaToolSuiteApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)

public interface ICreateProjectTaToolSuiteApi
    ICreateProjectTaToolSuiteApi provides means for specifying the new project's TA Tool Suite workspace settings.
    ICreateProjectTaToolSuiteApi contains the methods for specifying the new project's TA Tool Suite workspace settings.

        Create TA Tool Suite Workspace
        setCreateTaToolSuiteWorkspace(boolean) specifies whether or not to create a TA Tool Suite workspace for the new project. This is an optional parameter defaulting to false.

      • setTaToolSuiteExecutable

        @PublishedMethod
void setTaToolSuiteExecutable(@Nonnull
                                                java.lang.Object taToolSuiteExecutable)
        Sets the TA Tool Suite executable (TA Tool Suite.exe) for the new project.
        TA Tool Suite Executable
        Set the TA Tool Suite executable for the new project with setTaToolSuiteExecutable(Object).

        The value given here is converted to Path using ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH .

        The following constraints apply:

        • The path must point to a compatible TA Tool Suite executable (TA Tool Suite.exe).
        Parameters:
        taToolSuiteExecutable - the TA Tool Suite executable (TA Tool Suite.exe).

      • setTaToolSuiteWorkspace

        @PublishedMethod
void setTaToolSuiteWorkspace(@Nonnull
                                               java.lang.Object taToolSuiteWorkspace)
        Sets the TA Tool Suite workspace for the new project.
        TA Tool Suite Workspace
        Set the TA Tool Suite workspace for the new project with setTaToolSuiteWorkspace(Object). This is an optional parameter defaulting to
        "./Config/TA/" if the parameter is not provided explicitly.

        The value given here is converted to Path using ScriptConverters.TO_SCRIPT_PATH . Normally a relative path (to be interpreted relative to the project folder) should be given here.

        The following constraints apply:

        • Constraints.IS_CREATABLE_FOLDER (applies to the given Path to the TA Tool Suite workspace)
        Parameters:
        taToolSuiteWorkspace - the TA Tool Suite workspace for the new project
